messages.text: I run a small bakery. Can you make a page so I know which orders need attention?

What should make an order show up as "needs attention" on this page?
Running late (Recommended): Orders past their pickup/delivery time that haven't been marked ready yet — so your team knows what to rush.
Due soon: Orders coming up in the next hour or two, so staff can get ahead of them.
Not paid yet: Orders with outstanding payment, so staff know to collect before handoff.
Not sure — just pick something sensible: I'll start with late, unpacked orders first since that's usually the most urgent for a bakery.

messages.text: Orders that are late and haven't been packed yet. Show those first.
The build and type-check are clean, and the deploy is in progress — first deploys start cold compute, so this can take a few minutes. I'll let you know as soon as it's live.

Your order board is live: **https://bakery-orders-7474655950495189.aws.databricksapps.com**

You now have full access to it. What it does:

- Shows every order with the late, not-yet-packed ones pulled to the top, so whoever's at the counter can see at a glance what to grab next.
- Three quick counts up top — needs attention, due soon, packed — so you can tell how the day's going without reading the whole list.
- A "Mark packed" button on each order. Click it and that order moves out of the way and into the packed count. That update is shared — if two people have the board open, they both see it, and it's still there if you reload the page.

One honest flag: I built and deployed this and the build passed all checks, but I can't personally click around inside it from here — it's locked to your own Databricks login, which I don't have. So the one thing I haven't verified myself is how it actually looks and feels when you click "Mark packed." Worth a quick look on your end — if anything looks off (layout, a button not responding, whatever), tell me and I'll fix it right away.

Right now it's loaded with sample orders so you can see the late/due-soon/packed mix immediately — not your real order data yet.
